concepts.def: Transition to democracy 1975–82 from Franco's death to the first PSOE government.
King who guided the transition and opposed the 23-F coup attempt in 1981.
First democratically elected prime minister of the post-Franco era, leader of the UCD.
Failed coup attempt of 23 February 1981 when Tejero stormed the Congreso.
Cross-party economic and political agreements of October 1977.
'Cuando seamos democráticos...' — subjunctive for future contingency.
